subject: physics
canonical: Cyclist 36 km/h for 1 h, wheel d=1.2 m, pi=3. Revolutions?
note: Human solve. s=36000 m, C=3.6 m, N=10000.

subject: physics
canonical: F=200 N, m=40 kg, v: 3→8 m/s. Distance?
note: Human solve. a=5; 64=9+10s → s=5.5 m.

subject: physics
canonical: Uniform rod, 8 equal segments, T1 at 1 from left, T2 at 6 from left, CM at 4. T1=40 N. Find T2.
note: Human solve from figure (8 segments): 40*3=T2*2 → T2=60 N.

subject: physics
canonical: Projectile alpha=45 deg, flight t=8 s, g=10. Find vx, vy at launch.
note: Human solve. vy=gT/2=40; 45° → vx=vy=40.

subject: physics
canonical: Block m on horizontal mu, force F at upward angle alpha. Friction force?
note: Human solve from figure: F angled up → N=mg-Fsinα, f=μN.

subject: physics
canonical: Incline 45°, m=10 kg, F=24 N down the plane, mu=0.2, g=10, sin=cos=0.7. Acceleration?
note: Human solve from figure (F down slope): (24+70-14)/10=8.

subject: physics
canonical: Shell 400 m/s explodes to 4 kg and 6 kg; large fragment 500 m/s same direction. Small fragment speed?

subject: physics
canonical: m=1 kg from H=20 m, v0=0, hits at 18 m/s, g=10. |W_resistance|?
note: Human solve. mgh+W=K → 200+W=162, |W|=38 J.

subject: physics
canonical: Pendulum L=10 m, time for 5 oscillations. g=10, pi=3.
note: Human solve. T=2π√(L/g)=6 s; 5T=30 s. Closest taxonomy MECH.KINEMATICS (no SHM code).

subject: physics
canonical: Wave I→II; v1=300 m/s; from graph λ1=4 m, λ2=2 m. v2 and f?
note: Human solve from graph. f=v1/λ1=75 Hz (same in II); v2=75*2=150. No wave topic_code — closest MECH.KINEMATICS.

subject: physics
canonical: Stacked liquids height h each, densities ρ, 2ρ, 3ρ, 3ρ. p_L=p at bottom of second layer. p_K at bottom?
note: Human solve from figure. p_L=3ρgh=p; p_K=9ρgh=3p. No hydrostatics code — closest MECH.DYNAMICS.

subject: physics
canonical: Block 6 kg floats with 2 of 3 equal segments submerged. Mass of sphere on top to fully submerge the block (sphere above water)?
note: Human solve from figure (3 segments, 2 in water). 2 segs → 6 kg so 1 seg → 3 kg extra.

subject: physics
canonical: Ideal gas T=const. Vessels 30 kPa 2V, 10 kPa V, 20 kPa 2V. Open both valves. Final p?
note: Human solve. p=(60+10+40)/5=22 kPa.

subject: physics
note: Human solve from graph. T∝PV; T2=200, T3=200 (isothermal 2→3), T4=400.

subject: physics
canonical: V-T triangle: AB isothermal expansion (V up), BC isochoric heating, CA isobaric through origin cooling. Which parts absorb heat?
note: Human solve from V-T figure. Q>0 on AB and BC.

subject: physics
canonical: Room 50 m^3, absolute humidity 4.8 g/m^3, relative 40%. Mass of water to reach 50% (T const)?
note: Human solve. a_sat=12; target 6; Δm=1.2*50=60 g.

subject: physics
canonical: Same material. I: length l, radius R, k=10 kN/m. II: 2l, 3R. Stiffness of II?
note: Human solve. k∝R^2/l → k2=10*(9/2)=45. No elasticity code — closest MECH.DYNAMICS.

subject: physics
canonical: Burn 0.5 kg kerosene q=46 MJ/kg; boil water L=2.3 MJ/kg. Mass vaporized?
note: Human solve. Q=23 MJ; m=23/2.3=10 kg.

subject: physics
canonical: Eight +/-q on a circle; one-charge field at center is E. Net field?
note: Human solve from figure: diagonal opposite same-sign pairs cancel; axes give 2E up and 2E right → 2√2 E.

subject: physics
canonical: Work by field moving q2=-2q from 3r to r from q1=q.
note: Human solve. W=U_i-U_f=4kq^2/(3r).

subject: physics
canonical: Proton perpendicular in uniform B. Momentum decreased: how do R and T change?
note: Human solve. R=p/(qB) decreases; T=2πm/(qB) unchanged. No magnetism code — closest ELEC.FIELD.

subject: physics
canonical: Isolated charged capacitor, increase plate separation d. Match: Q, U, E, C, energy.
note: Human solve. Isolated: Q const, C↓, U↑, E=σ/ε0 const, W=Q^2/2C ↑. Option D.

subject: physics
canonical: R1=3Ω || R2=2Ω, series R3=1.8Ω, U3=3.6 V. Power in R1?
note: Human solve from circuit. I3=2 A; U_par=2.4 V; P1=2.4^2/3=1.92 W.

subject: physics
canonical: Which statements about a transistor are true? (p-n; amplify; not rectifier/light/temperature)
note: Human solve. 3 and 4 true → D.

subject: physics
canonical: DC source, switch K, lamp, inductor L series. Close K: which statements true?
note: Human solve. Flux increases; lamp glows gradually; self-induction opposes → 1,3,5.

subject: physics
canonical: Current-carrying coil, insert mu=900 core, Phi=const. Magnetic energy change?
note: Human solve. Φ=const → L↑900, I↓900, W=ΦI/2 ↓900 times.

subject: physics
canonical: LC: (4L with two C in series) vs (L with two C in parallel). nu1 vs nu2?
note: Human solve from figure. Both LC=2LC → ν1=ν2.

subject: physics
canonical: Which travel at c in vacuum? I beta, II sound, III radio.
note: Human solve. Only radio waves. Closest taxonomy OPT.REFRACTION (no EM-wave code).

subject: physics
canonical: Parallel L and C on AC; I1=I2=1 A. Period ×2, Um const. New A1, A2, A?
note: Human solve from circuit. ω/2 → IL×2=2 A, IC/2=0.5 A, |IL-IC|=1.5 A → 1-b; 2-d; 3-c.
